mbtiResult.name: 建筑师
mbtiResult.description: 富有想像力和战略性思想，冷静自信且具有批判性
mbtiResult.descriptionEn: Imaginative and strategic thinkers, with a plan for everything.

belbinRoles.name: 监督者
belbinRoles.description: 冷静分析和判断，权衡利弊做出正确决策
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Sober, strategic and discerning. Sees all options and judges accurately.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 冷静、有判断力、谨慎、逻辑性强
belbinRoles.contribution: 评估方案、识别风险、做出明智决策
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Judges accurately, weighs up the team's options in a dispassionate way
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 缺乏激励他人能力、可能过于批判
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Lacks drive and ability to inspire others, can be overly critical

belbinRoles.name: 智多星
belbinRoles.description: 富有想象力和创造力，善于解决复杂问题，提供创新想法
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Creative, imaginative, free-thinking. Generates ideas and solves difficult problems.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 聪明、好奇、独立思考、非传统
belbinRoles.contribution: 提供创新解决方案，解决复杂技术问题
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Generates ideas, solves difficult problems
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 忽视细节、不善于沟通、过于专注自己的想法
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Might ignore incidentals, too preoccupied to communicate effectively

belbinRoles.name: 专家
belbinRoles.description: 提供专业知识和技能，专注于特定领域
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Single-minded, self-starting, dedicated. Provides knowledge and skills in rare supply.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 专注、自我驱动、追求专业技能
belbinRoles.contribution: 提供专业知识、维护技术标准
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Provides knowledge and skills in rare supply
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 视野狭窄、难以参与其他领域工作
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Contributes only on a narrow front, dwells on technicalities

belbinRoles.name: 执行者
belbinRoles.description: 将想法转化为实际行动，纪律性强且高效
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Practical, reliable, efficient. Turns ideas into actions and organises work that needs to be done.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 纪律性、可靠、高效、保守

belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 缺乏灵活性、可能阻碍变革

belbinRoles.name: 完成者

belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Painstaking, conscientious, anxious. Searches out errors. Polishes and perfects.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 注重细节、焦虑、追求完美、有责任感
belbinRoles.contribution: 发现错误、确保质量、按时完成任务
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Searches out errors and omissions, delivers on time
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 担心过多、可能悲观、完美主义
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Inclined to worry unduly, reluctant to delegate

belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Sober, strategic and discerning. Sees all options and judges accurately.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 冷静、有判断力、谨慎、逻辑性强
belbinRoles.contribution: 评估方案、识别风险、做出明智决策
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Judges accurately, weighs up the team's options in a dispassionate way
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 缺乏激励他人能力、可能过于批判
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Lacks drive and ability to inspire others, can be overly critical

belbinRoles.name: 专家
belbinRoles.description: 提供专业知识和技能，专注于特定领域
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Single-minded, self-starting, dedicated. Provides knowledge and skills in rare supply.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 专注、自我驱动、追求专业技能
belbinRoles.contribution: 提供专业知识、维护技术标准
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Provides knowledge and skills in rare supply
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 视野狭窄、难以参与其他领域工作
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Contributes only on a narrow front, dwells on technicalities

belbinRoles.name: 推进者
belbinRoles.description: 充满活力和挑战精神，推动团队克服困难
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Challenging, dynamic, thrives on pressure. Has the drive and courage to overcome obstacles.

belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Co-operative, perceptive and diplomatic. Listens and averts friction.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 合作、适应性强、温和、有感知力
belbinRoles.contribution: 维护团队和谐、缓解冲突、支持他人
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Listens, builds, averts friction
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 在危机中犹豫不决、难以抉择
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Indecisive in crunch situations, can be easily influenced

mbtiResult.name: 主人公
mbtiResult.description: 热情且有魅力，关心他人且具有领导力
mbtiResult.descriptionEn: Charismatic and inspiring leaders, able to mesmerize listeners.

belbinRoles.name: 协调者
belbinRoles.description: 成熟的领导者，能引导团队向目标前进
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Mature, confident, identifies talent. Clarifies goals. Delegates effectively.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 自信、有威望、善于识别他人优势
belbinRoles.contribution: 明确目标、分配任务、促进团队合作
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Clarifies goals, promotes decision-making, delegates well
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 可能操控他人、缺乏激情
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Can be seen as manipulative, might offload their own share of the work

belbinRoles.name: 资源调查者
belbinRoles.description: 善于发现和探索机会，外向且充满好奇心
belbinRoles.descriptionEn: Outgoing, enthusiastic. Explores opportunities and develops contacts.
belbinRoles.characteristics: 外向、热情、好奇、沟通能力强
belbinRoles.contribution: 拓展人脉、获取资源、探索新机会
belbinRoles.contributionEn: Explores opportunities, develops contacts
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknesses: 容易失去兴趣、缺乏深度跟进
belbinRoles.allowable_weaknessesEn: Might be over-optimistic, can lose interest once the initial enthusiasm has passed
